h1: Lampang River Lodge — Lanna Villas on the Wang River Across 25 Quiet Acres
intro: Lampang already moves slowly, but Lampang River Lodge - Lanna Riverside Resort slows it down further · a boutique resort that scatters Lanna-style villas across 25+ acres of gardens on the Wang River, about 9 km from town · you trade easy walks to Kad Kong Ta for big shade trees, open lawns, and a quiet you won't find at a city hotel · 60 rooms, from approx ฿1,100/night.

Bar and lounge corner in the Lanna garden setting of the resort
Riverside restaurant at Lampang River Lodge decorated in warm Lanna wood tones

body.html: What sets this place apart from Lampang's city hotels is that it's a genuine resort in a garden, not a building on a road · the 25-plus acres are laid out as low villa blocks scattered among big old trees, with lawns, shaded paths, and the Wang River running along one side · reviewers agree that the moment you drive through the gate the city noise drops away, leaving birds and rustling leaves — exactly what road-trippers exploring the north look for when they want one quiet night.

There are 60 rooms in total, ranging from Standard rooms and Lanna House villas to Superior rooms with balconies, family rooms, and Lakeview Deluxe units whose balconies face the water · interiors lean on warm Lanna wood tones — not luxurious, but homely and relaxed · many rooms have been renovated, and recent guests say they're cleaner and newer-looking than expected at this price · one thing to know: the villas are spread out, so some rooms are a fair walk from the car park — ask staff for help if your bags are heavy.
"Driving in felt like slipping into another garden world — so quiet. Morning coffee by the river with birdsong was worth being a little out of town."

The outdoor pool sits in the middle of the gardens, shaded by mature trees all around · it isn't a fancy infinity pool, but the cool, quiet setting is what guests like · beyond the pool there are wide lawns for a morning walk or jog, and a feature people often mention is the bicycle and horse-cart rental for riding or riding around the riverside gardens — the horse cart is a Lampang signature, and getting to try it in a resort setting is a hit with kids and adults alike.

The riverside restaurant serves Thai and northern dishes with seats looking out over the Wang River · breakfast is where reviews split — some love the setting and the view, but others find breakfast plain with a limited spread · the other thing to plan for is that the resort is out of town, so come evening, if you want food beyond the hotel you'll need to drive into the city rather than stroll out to nearby restaurants the way you would in central Kad Kong Ta.

Location is both the draw and the trade-off · the resort is in Chomphu, about 9 km from central Lampang and Kad Kong Ta, roughly a 15-minute drive · the upside is the calm, the wide gardens, and clean air, which suits families with a car who want the kids to run around · the trade-off is that without your own car it's awkward — every trip into town for the walking street or temples means arranging transport · it's on the route toward Wat Phra That Lampang Luang and the Thai Elephant Conservation Center, two of Lampang's main sights.

Honestly, this isn't the choice for someone who wants to stay in town and step straight into the nightlife · the recurring caveats are the breakfast some call plain, uneven cleanliness in a few rooms, limited English at the front desk, and the odd insect because you're in the middle of woodland · but if what you're after is wide gardens, riverside quiet, and a Lanna-style stay at a price many call good value — this resort delivers, and the 8.6 score from 62 Trip.com reviews reflects that.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: if you want the full riverside feel, ask for a Lakeview room with a balcony over the water at the time of booking · families should ask about horse-cart and bicycle slots in advance — kids love them · and because it's out of town, having your own car makes a Lampang trip much easier when you stay here.

honestSummary: Lampang River Lodge is at its best for travellers who want wide gardens on the Wang River, quiet, and a Lanna-style stay at a price many call good value · but accept that it's about 9 km out of town, you'll really want your own car, and breakfast isn't its strong point.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Lampang River Lodge

faq.q: Where is Lampang River Lodge and what's nearby?
faq.a: The resort is at 330 Moo 11, Chomphu, Mueang Lampang, on the Wang River · about 9 km from central Lampang and Kad Kong Ta (roughly a 15-minute drive) · it's on the route toward Wat Phra That Lampang Luang and the Thai Elephant Conservation Center · the location is built around riverside garden quiet rather than walking into town, so you'll want your own car.

faq.q: How much does Lampang River Lodge cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿1,100/night for a Standard room · Lanna House villas run about ฿1,400 · Lanna Superior with a balcony about ฿1,700 · Lakeview Deluxe rooms with a balcony over the river move up to around ฿2,200 · rates vary by season and holidays, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Lampang River Lodge best for?
faq.a: It's at its best for families and couples driving themselves who want wide gardens on the Wang River and quiet · there's space for kids to play, plus bicycle and horse-cart rental around the gardens · it isn't ideal for travellers without a car or those who want to stay by Kad Kong Ta and step into the nightlife.

faq.q: What activities and facilities are there?
faq.a: There's an outdoor pool in the gardens, a riverside restaurant, and bicycle plus horse-cart rental for exploring the Wang River grounds · the 25-plus acres have wide lawns for a morning walk or jog · the horse cart is a Lampang signature you get to try in a resort setting, an activity kids and adults both enjoy.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book and is cancellation possible?
faq.a: During the cool season (November–January) and long holidays, book several weeks ahead as Lampang's pleasant cool weather draws crowds and riverside rooms fill fast · every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm yet.

faq.q: Is breakfast good and is it included?
faq.a: Breakfast is served at the riverside restaurant with a view over the Wang River · reviews split — some love the setting, others find the choices limited · some packages include breakfast, so check at booking, and since it's out of town, plan your main meals ahead.
